title: Vendor Onboarding Readiness Checker
description: Checks vendor onboarding evidence for requested controls, named ownership, expiry, and review status.
decision: Onboarding evidence is ready for human review when every required control has a current, reviewed artifact and an owner.
inputs: The caller supplies required control IDs and evidence records with artifact reference, owner, review state, and days until expiry.
limitations: This does not assess vendor trustworthiness, certify compliance, or replace procurement, legal, privacy, or security review.

input_schema.description: The caller supplies required control IDs and evidence records with artifact reference, owner, review state, and days until expiry.
